name: 🌳Build To Climb! [Season 2]
desc:
☁️ Welcome to Build To Climb! ☁️
🌎Start from a little stack and build a Great Tall Building! Reaching the sky to unlock New Theme!

[How to Play]
💰Buy stacks from the shop!
🧱Pile Up your stacks!
💸Climb and jump to earn coins!
☁️Keep building higher and higher!
